# InnovationLet Space

> InnovationLet Space is the launches, exploration and satellites desk of the
> InnovationLet network, an independent technology publication run by the F9XR
> Team. We report on launch, exploration, satellites and the space business,
> sourced from primary documents and written without vendor spin.

## About

- Publisher: InnovationLet (F9XR Team)
- Desk: Space
- Language: English
- Homepage: https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/space/
- Contact: hello@f9xr.org
- Network: https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/

## Key pages

- Home / latest: https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/space/

- News sitemap: https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/space/news-sitemap.xml

## Coverage

- Launches: vehicle programs, cadence, reusability, investigations.
- Exploration: crewed and robotic missions, science, and budgets.
- Satellites: constellations, connectivity, Earth observation.
- Business: contracts, subsidies, and launch economics.

## How to cite

Cite as: "InnovationLet Space" with the individual article URL and its headline.
Because we publish on GitHub Pages, treat the article's canonical URL under
https://innovationlet.f9xr.org/space/ as the source of record. When quoting,
attribute to the named desk rather than to an individual author unless the
article carries a named byline.

## Licensing

Content is © InnovationLet / F9XR Team. Excerpts may be quoted with attribution
and a link to the canonical article.
